objective: Refresh DSH-Store and build-dsh-plugin compatibility evidence and make their CI test the official latest-three DSH release window dynamically.

authority.latestThreeSource: official GitHub Releases and published npm versions

gates: Resolve exactly the current official three-release window and fail closed on partial or invalid authority.
Run install, configuration composition, cold start, host probe, uninstall, and rollback checks only in disposable DSH_HOME instances.
Mark an exact release compatible only after its matrix job passes; never infer compatibility from a semver range.
Run npm run check and all repository CI before submitting each source PR.
Update Catalog only through the dedicated policy workflow after source merges; confirm public Catalog readback separately.
prohibitions: Do not modify DSH source or any @deepseek-ai/* package.
Do not write to ~/.dsh or any real Profile, install plugins there, or restart the running DSH.
Do not send author outreach or bypass the central contact ledger.
Do not mark unverified releases compatible or listed.

rollback.source: Revert the exact merged source commit in each repository; preserve the plan and all unrelated history.
rollback.catalog: Use the dedicated Catalog policy workflow's recorded pre-change backup and reversible status transition.
rollback.profile: No real Profile mutation is in scope.

healthChecks: GitHub PR CI is green for the exact latest-three resolver output.
Each compatibility result records the DSH version, source commit, operation results, and disposable Profile identity.
The Catalog's fixed source and public marketplace surfaces are read back after the policy workflow completes.
